events.description: A violent clash between a group of civilians and police officers in riot gear on a city street; individuals are pushing, shoving, and grappling while others raise hands or hold banners, indicating collective unrest.
Mutual physical combat is visible among multiple individuals: two men in dark jackets are actively grappling and striking each other amid the crowd, with others intervening or joining the scuffle.

A violent clash between a group of protesters and police officers in riot gear on a city street, involving pushing, shoving, and physical confrontation; the crowd surges forward while police attempt to hold a line, with multiple individuals engaged in collective unrest.

Direct physical combat between individuals: protesters and police are seen grappling, grabbing, and striking each other at close range (e.g., frame f4 shows two men in black jackets wrestling while police intervene; frame f5 shows a man being pulled down amid melee).
Large-scale violent clash between police in riot gear (blue helmets, body armor) and a crowd of civilians on a city street; includes pushing, shoving, running, and use of batons by officers.
Direct physical combat between individual police officers and civilians: one officer swings a baton while engaging a civilian at close range; others are seen grappling and striking.

A large crowd of demonstrators is gathered in front of the Colosseum, with smoke (likely from flares or tear gas) rising among them; banners are visible and the atmosphere indicates collective unrest. In later frames (26.0–27.5), a dense cloud of white smoke erupts near the crowd, consistent with deployment of crowd-control agents or pyrotechnics during a protest.
A line of riot police in full gear (helmets, shields marked 'POLIZIA') forms a defensive cordon on a street, indicating preparation for or response to civil unrest.

A large crowd is gathered in front of the Colosseum (frames f0–f3), with visible smoke (blue/white) rising from within or near the crowd, suggesting deployment of smoke canisters or flares. The scene transitions to a street setting (frames f4–f15) where dense white smoke erupts among the crowd, people are raising phones/cameras, and some individuals appear to be retreating or reacting to the smoke. The sustained presence of smoke, crowd agitation, and apparent use of crowd-control agents indicate collective violent unrest or violent group clashes.

A dense crowd in an urban street is enveloped in thick white smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades), with individuals raising cameras and phones, some retreating or shielding themselves; visible agitation, movement, and presence of multiple journalists suggest a violent unrest or clash between protesters and authorities.

A crowd of people, including journalists with cameras, is engulfed in a dense cloud of white smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) in an urban street; individuals are raising arms, some holding cameras aloft, and there is visible agitation and movement consistent with a violent unrest or clash.

Police in blue helmets and riot gear form a line confronting a large crowd in front of a pharmacy storefront; the crowd presses forward, many holding cameras, and the scene shows active confrontation and physical proximity indicative of violent group clash.
